## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is an exceptionally capable woman and a clever manager who effortlessly handles her own affairs as well as those of others. Known throughout [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as a red-hot politician, she is a shrewd judge of human nature, highly observant, and very farseeing, though she holds decided prejudices against anyone born outside of Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island). Characterized as an outspoken, bossy, and somewhat officious gossip, she takes pride in speaking her mind, often nagging people to do right and finding fault with those around her. Despite her critical, practical, and sometimes pessimistic nature—alongside a firm belief in foreordination and a dark dubiousness toward writing fiction—she possesses a truly kind heart, genuine generosity, and a willingness to help the poor. As a devout church member, she considers horse racing an abomination and strictly avoids it to set a good religious example.

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived as [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's neighbor for forty-five years, having married when she was eighteen and previously had a husband who was cheated out of ten dollars in [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston). After raising ten children who went to school, she visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to express skepticism upon learning [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) intended to adopt an orphan boy. When a young girl named [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrived instead, Mrs. Lynde visited and insulted her appearance, provoking a furious outburst from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before eventually receiving a dramatic apology and forgiving her. Later, when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refused to return to school after a humiliation, Mrs. Lynde advised [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let the girl stay home until she cooled off. She assisted [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) by making a new dress with puffed sleeves for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas), and later praised Anne's beauty and growth to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Following the sudden death of her husband, [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), Mrs. Lynde accepted Marilla's invitation to move to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), allowing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to leave her teaching job and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she provided [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) with company and helped keep watch over the Keith twins, occasionally having her strict instructions disobeyed by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). ## Quotes

> "She’s terrible skinny and homely, Marilla. Come here, child, and let me have a look at you. Lawful heart, did any one ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots! Come here, child, I say."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I saw Mr. Harrison chasing your Jersey out of his oats today when I was coming home from Carmody. I thought he looked pretty mad. Did he make much of a rumpus?"
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)

> "I knew there’d be trouble when Robert Bell sold his place to a New Brunswick man, that’s what. I don’t know what Avonlea is coming to, with so many strange people rushing into it. It’ll soon not be safe to go to sleep in our beds."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043)

> "I’m not supposed to know anything about her arrival, and Mr. Harrison was to bring some medicine for Thomas from Carmody today, so that will be a good excuse. I’ll find out the whole story and come in and tell you on the way back."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P32](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0032)

## Relationships

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel Lynde and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) are long-time neighbors and close friends who frequently visit each other to share gossip and advice. Their relationship began on a rocky note when Rachel strongly criticized Marilla's decision to adopt an orphan, though they remain constant companions who even travel together to local events. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) often consults Rachel on household matters and child-rearing, valuing her outspoken opinions despite their occasional differences.

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel Lynde initially offends [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) by criticizing her looks, prompting a fiery outburst from the young girl. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers a dramatic apology, Rachel forgives her, and their relationship softens into a fond neighborly acquaintance. Rachel frequently offers advice regarding Anne's upbringing and schoolwork, eventually coming to praise Anne's beauty, intellect, and success as a schoolteacher.

- Friend of — neighbors and acquaintances who interact over household requests (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P25](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0025), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)</sub>

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel Lynde and [Emily](../character/emily.md) [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) are neighbors in the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community. Rachel takes an active interest in Emily's unexpected arrival and her sudden reconciliation with her husband, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), frequently chatting about the couple's affairs with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

- Friend of — neighbors and shopping companions (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P5](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0005)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel Lynde knows [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) as one of Anne's young pupils in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She takes note of his presence in the community alongside the other school children, while staying informed about classroom events through her discussions with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
